card.name: Verbs of meeting needs or criteria
card.fires_on: The verb "meet"/"meets" and nearby words in phrases like "meet the body's needs" or "meet criteria". Also words after "questions" such as "they may have", and "the" after "affected".

modes.label: Meeting needs or criteria
modes.description: "meet" or "meets" followed by needs, criteria or diagnostic standards.
modes.example: does not pump blood efficiently enough to<< meet>> the body's needs.

modes.label: Questions patients may have
modes.description: Words after "questions" or "ask any questions" that lead into "may have" or "might have".
modes.example: to obtain answers to any questions<< they>> may have.

modes.label: Words completing a verb phrase
modes.description: Words like "the", "addressed" or "heal" that finish a short verb phrase about concerns or effects.
modes.example: These infections have affected<< the>> brain, meninges, spinal cord,

card.plain: It fires on the verb "meet" in phrases like meeting the body's needs or meeting criteria, and on a few similar phrases.
